findings_qualitative.value: LBG-1 SED resembles dwarf galaxies, not spirals/starbursts

evidence.quote: The spectral energy distribution of these galaxies is inconsistent with nearby spiral and starburst galaxies, but resembles those of dwarf galaxies.
